title: [suite à La "Longue Marche" à travers la théorie de Galois..., pages 650 bis à 787, dont table des matières] : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
This is page 707 of the continuation of 'La Longue Marche' (pp. 650 bis–787). The page is purely computational: it fixes one explicit trivialisation of an extension studied on the preceding pages.

Setting, as far as it can be inferred from this page and its neighbours:
- M (resp. M^ or Γ M) is a free rank-2 module, the abelianised fundamental group of a genus-1 fibre. It contains three distinguished classes λ_0, λ_1, λ_∞ with λ_0 + λ_1 + λ_∞ = 0, the loops around the three branch points 0, 1, ∞.
- H^+ is an SL_2-type modular group generated by an element ρ of order 3 or 6 and an element σ of order 2 or 4 (cf. SL_2(Z) = Z/4 *_{Z/2} Z/6). μ_{H^+} is its centre, and G_3 ≅ H^+/μ_{H^+} is the PSL_2-type quotient.
- 𝔊^+ is an extension of H^+ by M, an affine group of type M ⋊ H^+.
- 𝕆_12^* (profinite incarnation Ẑ^*) carries the arithmetic or cyclotomic part. χ is the cyclotomic character, and ν(μ) is an integer invariant attached to μ, apparently a mod-12 quantity.

Previous page. G_{ρ,σ}, an extension of 𝕆_12^* × H^+ by M, admits no splitting over any non-empty S. Its restriction G''_{ρ,σ} over a subgroup 𝕆_12^*'' does split, uniquely up to conjugation by a section of M. Splittings of G'' correspond bijectively to splittings of 𝔊^+ (written B^+ there) over H^+.

This page.
1. Splittings of 𝔊^+ → H^+ are written as ρ' = ρ + ζ, σ' = σ + η (additive notation on M), with ζ, η in M. The cocycle conditions coming from the relations of H^+ reduce to the affine equation (273): a_0 − 2a_1 + 3b − 1 = 0 in the coordinates of ζ and η.
2. The particular solution a_1 = b = 0, a_0 = 1 gives (274): ζ = λ_0, η = 0, i.e. ρ' = λ_0 ρ and σ' = σ. This also yields formulas for the induced lifting to G_3 ≅ H^+/μ_{H^+}.
3. The corresponding liftings are (275): u_{ρ',σ'}: 𝕆_12^* → G_{ρ,σ}/μ_G (resp. 𝕆_12^*'' → G_{ρ,σ}), μ ↦ λ_∞^ν u_μ. Here u_μ is the reference lift defined in (151).
4. This is checked against (264)–(265) on p. 704, which give the correction term λ = xλ_0 + yλ_1 with x = y = −ν. Hence λ = −ν(λ_0 + λ_1) = νλ_∞.
5. Setting u'_μ = u_{ρ',σ'}(μ) gives the characterisation (276): u'_μ fixes ρ' and σ', and acts on M by multiplication by the cyclotomic scalar χ(μ). In other words, the arithmetic group acts on M ⋊ H^+ purely by homotheties on M after a suitable choice of section.
6. The next page deduces (277): u'_μ(ρ) = λ_0^{−2ν} ρ and u'_μ(σ) = ω^{1/2} σ.

The purpose is to make explicit the Galois (Ẑ^*) action on the genus-1 'modular' extension in normal form. The non-splitting over the full Ẑ^* is concentrated in the term λ_∞^{ν(μ)}, a 12-type obstruction.
errors: The transcription's '−ν(λ_0 + λ_∞) = νλ_∞' is inconsistent. Since λ = xλ_0 + yλ_1 with x = y = −ν, it must read −ν(λ_0 + λ_1) = νλ_∞, using λ_0 + λ_1 + λ_∞ = 0. Either the manuscript has a slip of the pen or the transcription misread λ_1.
Inside (276), λ denotes a general element of Γ M, a reuse of the symbol already used for the correction term λ = νλ_∞. This is harmless but confusing.
The verification of (273) against the defining relations of H^+ is not on this page, so it cannot be checked here. The particular solution (1, 0, 0) does satisfy (273).

ideas.what: Parametrisation of the splittings of an affine extension M ⋊ H^+ (H^+ an SL_2-type amalgam) by an affine linear equation, followed by choice of an explicit normal-form splitting ρ' = λ_0 ρ, σ' = σ
ideas.modern_name: explicit 1-cocycles / H^1(SL_2(Z), Z^2) via the amalgam presentation

ideas.what: Explicit lift of the cyclotomic/arithmetic group into the extension, characterised by fixing the chosen splitting and acting on M by the cyclotomic character; correction term λ_∞^{ν(μ)} measuring non-splitting over all of Ẑ^*
ideas.modern_name: Galois action on the profinite (abelianised) genus-1 / modular fundamental group; 12-torsion obstruction (cf. Pic(M_{1,1}) = Z/12, Dedekind–Rademacher type cocycle)
ideas.usually_credited_to: Nakamura, Ihara, Hain–Matsumoto for Galois actions on genus-1 fundamental groups (1990s–2000s)
ideas.where_published: La Longue Marche (1981, circulated) treats related material; this continuation is unpublished

missed.claim: This is an explicit normal form for the arithmetic action on M ⋊ H^+: after the choice ρ' = λ_0ρ, σ' = σ, the Galois element acts by fixing ρ' and σ' and by the cyclotomic scalar on M, at the cost of the factor λ_∞^{ν(μ)}. It is a worked computation within Grothendieck's unpublished genus-1 analysis. Taken alone it is routine, but it documents his handling of the 12-type non-splitting.
missed.quote: u'_μ(ρ') = ρ', u'_μ(σ') = σ' ; u'_μ(λ) = μλ (λ ∈ Γ M) (où μ = χ(μ))
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: It may be of historical interest when comparing with later explicit treatments of Galois actions on the genus-1 modular/elliptic fundamental group (e.g. Nakamura's), but it is not a new result in itself.

deep.surprise_reason: Routine explicit computation: a particular solution of a linear cocycle equation and the resulting formula for a lifting. The conceptual statements (non-splitting, splitting over a subgroup) are on the previous page, and this page only makes them explicit.
transcription_corrections: 'λ = −ν(λ_0 + λ_∞) = νλ_∞' should be 'λ = −ν(λ_0 + λ_1) = νλ_∞' (λ_0 + λ_1 + λ_∞ = 0); the manuscript may itself contain the slip.
'les vos[?] formules' is likely 'les mêmes formules' or 'ces formules' (uncertain); the line continues with 'en lisant dans G_3 ≅ H^+/μ_{H^+}' rather than 'en lisses[?]'.
'(NB (275) est contenu dans par. p. 704' likely reads 'est contenu dans (ou résulte de) p. 704 (265) et (264)'.
In (275) the exponent over λ_∞ is ν, as stated in the parenthesis ν = ν(μ); the image shows 'λ_∞^ν u_μ'.
